_comment: Spoken English course (Vinayak K Ramachandran), published with the author's permission. What the PDFs cannot give reliably is curated here: the vocabulary exercises (three layouts), the story extras (blanks with their answers, discussion questions, vocabulary lists) and text fixes. Each vocabulary item becomes a card: pt is the prompt (our translation), en the course's example.

blanks.meaning: stopped briefly before doing or saying something
get rid of a feeling, thought or problem
finally decide to do something difficult or risky
cautious because you are aware of possible problems or danger
stopped and considered a situation more calmly
deal with problems directly rather than avoiding them
produced a good result after effort or difficulty

questions: Have you ever had to take the plunge and make a difficult decision?
Are you generally comfortable stepping outside your comfort zone? Why or why not?
How do you usually handle problems when you're under pressure?
Do you think making mistakes is necessary for personal growth?
What is something you've done recently that eventually paid off?

vocabulary.definition: Extremely important for the operation of a business.
vocabulary.en: I manage business-critical production environments where downtime can have a significant impact.
vocabulary.pt: Eu gerencio ambientes de produção críticos para o negócio, onde uma indisponibilidade pode ter um impacto significativo.

vocabulary.definition: The regular tasks and responsibilities involved in a job.
vocabulary.en: My day-to-day activities include monitoring infrastructure and troubleshooting production issues.
vocabulary.pt: Minhas atividades do dia a dia incluem monitorar a infraestrutura e resolver problemas de produção.

vocabulary.definition: Ensuring that a system remains operational and accessible with minimal interruptions.
vocabulary.en: One of my primary responsibilities is maintaining high availability across our production environments.
vocabulary.pt: Uma das minhas principais responsabilidades é manter a alta disponibilidade dos nossos ambientes de produção.

vocabulary.definition: To identify and resolve problems with a system or piece of equipment.
vocabulary.en: I regularly troubleshoot Kubernetes-related issues in production.
vocabulary.pt: Eu investigo e resolvo com frequência problemas de Kubernetes em produção.

vocabulary.en: We maintain infrastructure that supports business operations around the clock.
vocabulary.pt: Mantemos uma infraestrutura que sustenta as operações do negócio 24 horas por dia.

vocabulary.definition: To reduce interruptions or negative effects.
vocabulary.en: We carefully plan infrastructure upgrades to minimize disruption to customers.
vocabulary.pt: Planejamos com cuidado as atualizações de infraestrutura para minimizar o impacto nos clientes.

vocabulary.definition: To have an important influence or contribution.
vocabulary.en: Automation plays a significant role in improving infrastructure reliability.
vocabulary.pt: A automação tem um papel importante em melhorar a confiabilidade da infraestrutura.

vocabulary.en: We automate repetitive tasks to improve efficiency and reduce human error.
vocabulary.pt: Automatizamos tarefas repetitivas para ganhar eficiência e reduzir o erro humano.

vocabulary.definition: To work together with other people towards a common goal.
vocabulary.en: I regularly collaborate with developers and security engineers.
vocabulary.pt: Colaboro com frequência com desenvolvedores e engenheiros de segurança.

items.en: I decided to stay home instead of going out.
items.pt: Decidi ficar em casa em vez de sair.

items.en: She answered the question without hesitation.
items.pt: Ela respondeu à pergunta sem hesitar.

items.en: I'm having second thoughts about buying this car.
items.pt: Estou repensando se compro este carro.

items.en: Did you notice anything unusual?
items.pt: Você notou algo fora do normal?

items.en: Don't worry about making mistakes.
items.pt: Não se preocupe em errar.

items.en: He walked toward the door.
items.pt: Ele caminhou em direção à porta.

items.en: I completely forgot about the meeting.
items.pt: Esqueci completamente da reunião.

items.en: She is willing to help us.
items.pt: Ela está disposta a nos ajudar.

items.en: Please read the instructions carefully.
items.pt: Por favor, leia as instruções com atenção.

items.en: Let's pause for a moment and think about it.
items.pt: Vamos parar um momento e pensar nisso.

items.en: I couldn't shake off the feeling that something was wrong.
items.pt: Eu não conseguia me livrar da sensação de que algo estava errado.

items.en: We need to tackle this problem together.
items.pt: Precisamos encarar esse problema juntos.

items.en: She knows how to handle difficult situations.
items.pt: Ela sabe lidar com situações difíceis.

items.en: Sometimes, it's better to take a step back and look at the situation calmly.
items.pt: Às vezes é melhor dar um passo atrás e olhar a situação com calma.

items.en: You should be wary of people you don't know.
items.pt: Você deve desconfiar de pessoas que não conhece.

items.en: I've been thinking about learning Portuguese, and I've finally decided to take the plunge.
items.pt: Venho pensando em aprender português e finalmente decidi me jogar.

items.en: All your hard work will eventually pay off.
items.pt: Todo o seu esforço vai valer a pena no fim.

items.term: step outside of your comfort zone
items.en: Trying something new can help you step outside of your comfort zone.
items.pt: Tentar algo novo pode te ajudar a sair da sua zona de conforto.

items.en: I decided to take a chance and apply for the job.
items.pt: Decidi arriscar e me candidatar à vaga.

items.en: It would be sensible to leave early.
items.pt: Seria sensato sair cedo.

items.en: I didn't realize that it was already midnight.
items.pt: Não percebi que já era meia-noite.

items.en: I wanted to go out. However, I was too tired.
items.pt: Eu queria sair. Porém, estava cansado demais.

items.en: She always complains about her job.
items.pt: Ela sempre reclama do trabalho.

items.en: Don't blame me for the mistake.
items.pt: Não me culpe pelo erro.

items.en: We need to follow the correct procedure.
items.pt: Precisamos seguir o procedimento correto.

items.en: Don't criticize him before hearing his side of the story.
items.pt: Não critique ele antes de ouvir o lado dele da história.

items.en: Are you aware of the problem?
items.pt: Você está ciente do problema?

items.en: She lives in a tiny house near the beach.
items.pt: Ela mora numa casa minúscula perto da praia.

items.definition: To break into pieces or stop working properly; it can also mean to lose emotional control.
items.en: He fell apart when he heard the heartbreaking news.
items.pt: Ele desmoronou quando ouviu a notícia devastadora.

items.definition: To find or discover something by chance.
items.en: I came across an interesting book while cleaning my room.
items.pt: Encontrei por acaso um livro interessante enquanto arrumava meu quarto.

items.definition: To make something completely wet by putting it in liquid.
items.en: She soaked her clothes in water before washing them.
items.pt: Ela deixou as roupas de molho na água antes de lavá-las.

items.definition: To fall in small drops of liquid.
items.en: Water was dripping from the kitchen tap.
items.pt: A água estava pingando da torneira da cozinha.

items.definition: To move your head up and down to show agreement or understanding.
items.en: He nodded his head to show that he understood the instructions.
items.pt: Ele acenou com a cabeça para mostrar que tinha entendido as instruções.

items.definition: Breathing quickly and deeply, usually because of physical effort or strong emotions.
items.en: He was breathing heavily after running up the stairs.
items.pt: Ele estava ofegante depois de subir a escada correndo.

items.definition: A feeling in the throat that happens when someone is about to cry or feels strong emotions.
items.en: I had a lump in my throat when I said goodbye to my best friend.
items.pt: Fiquei com um nó na garganta quando me despedi do meu melhor amigo.

items.definition: A feeling of being unable to believe something because it is surprising or shocking.
items.en: She stared at the message in disbelief when she learned that she had won the competition.
items.pt: Ela olhou para a mensagem sem acreditar quando soube que tinha vencido a competição.
